<h2 style="margin-left: 17.75pt;" class="akch-demoted-h1">Web Server Compromise</h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: left; line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 0cm 7.9pt 17.75pt;" align="left"><b style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal;">Background:</b>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 4.55pt 8.55pt 18.4pt;">Help! I was creating a blog to talk about my research and I think it was hacked! It is now advertising free essay papers. All I had done is install WordPress and and a few plugins.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: left; line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 0cm 7.9pt 17.75pt;" align="left"><b style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal;">Assignment:</b>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 11.0pt 8.55pt 18.4pt;">This is a group project where you will work as a team of incident responders.<span style="mso-spacerun: yes;">&nbsp; </span>You will be placed into teams of three.<span style="mso-spacerun: yes;">&nbsp; </span>Working with your partner, you will use the logs and site directory to figure out what happened and when. The deliverable for this assignment is an incident report.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: left; line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 0cm 7.9pt 17.75pt;" align="left"><b style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal;">Steps:</b>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 4.55pt 13.3pt 18.4pt;">We will be teaching using Splunk, but if you are more comfortable using Elastic (ELK) or some other log searching mechanism you are free to do so. The raw logs are attached to this assignment below. While you can definitely succeed at this assignment using plain old grep, I would recommend you don’t. While grep will work due to the small size of the log files being provided, grep fails to perform when you are in an actual Enterprise with massive amounts of data. To access Splunk:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l1 level1 lfo2; margin: 0cm 4.55pt .25pt 35.9pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">1.<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]-->Log in to the Georgia Tech VPN

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; line-height: 107%; mso-list: l1 level1 lfo2; margin: 0cm 4.55pt 0cm 35.9pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">2.<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]-->Navigate to <a href="https://splunk.class.security.gatech.edu/"><span style="color: #004f9f;">https://splunk.class.security.gatech.edu</span></a> <a href="https://splunk.class.security.gatech.edu/"><span style="color: #004f9f;">(Links</span></a> <a href="https://splunk.class.security.gatech.edu/"><span style="color: #004f9f;">to</span></a> <a href="https://splunk.class.security.gatech.edu/"><span style="color: #004f9f;">an</span></a> <a href="https://splunk.class.security.gatech.edu/"><span style="color: #004f9f;">external</span></a> <a href="https://splunk.class.security.gatech.edu/"><span style="color: #004f9f;">site.)</span></a>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l1 level1 lfo2; margin: 0cm 4.55pt .25pt 35.9pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">3.<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]-->Log in with your GT username and password 4. Click “Search and Reporting”

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 4.55pt 13.8pt 18.4pt;">5. Start searching!

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 10.4pt 8.55pt 18.4pt;">The data for this assignment is in the “project2” index. You can see all of the data by searching for “index=project2” and changing the time dialog from “Last 24 hours” to “All time.” Splunk already has the fields extracted from the logs for you.<span style="mso-spacerun: yes;">&nbsp; </span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: left; line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 0cm 7.9pt 17.75pt;" align="left"><b style="mso-bidi-font-weight: normal;">Incident Report:</b>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 13.0pt .25pt 18.4pt;">Write an incident report based on this assignment. Use the provided template from additional resources. The audience for this report will be your executive leadership and the affected business unit leadership.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 4.55pt 13.5pt 18.4pt;">As discussed in the report writing lecture, make sure to include (these are all sections in the template):

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l2 level1 lfo3; margin: 0cm 9.9pt .25pt 35.9pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; line-height: 104%;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span><!--[endif]-->An executive summary

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l2 level1 lfo3; margin: 0cm 9.9pt .25pt 35.9pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; line-height: 104%;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span><!--[endif]-->A detailed timeline of the incident. Include detail of the attack

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l2 level1 lfo3; margin: 0cm 9.9pt .25pt 35.9pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; line-height: 104%;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span><!--[endif]-->Any containment and eradication steps that you would have taken. (e.g. would you have requested that the web server be restored from back up?). Document these steps as if you had taken them (e.g. At 12:05pm the security team requested the web server be restored from previous clean back up)

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; line-height: 103%; mso-list: l2 level1 lfo3; margin: 0cm 9.9pt 0cm 35.9pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; line-height: 103%;"><span style="mso-list: Ignore;">•<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span></span><!--[endif]-->Financial impact <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">o</span> Include effort estimates for your investigation and the time resources from any other involved teams

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: left; text-indent: 19.2pt; line-height: 103%; margin: 0cm 81.05pt 17.5pt 17.9pt;" align="left"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">o</span> Anything else you can think of that might have had financial impact <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">o</span> The numbers can be completely made up <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Segoe UI Symbol',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Segoe UI Symbol'; mso-bidi-font-family: 'Segoe UI Symbol';">•</span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%;"> <span style="mso-tab-count: 1;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span>Lessons learned
